observations.note: For POST /api/verifyLogin, DELETE /api/verifyLogin, GET /api/getUserDetailByEmail, PUT /api/updateAccount and DELETE /api/deleteAccount, the endpoint entry's own "source" cites only the relative-path heading line (e.g. #L59), not the base-URL line (#L9) that supplies the "/api" prefix. The full path is still correctly derived — the combination is spelled out in gap G1's evidence — but the individual endpoint entries would be clearer if they also cited #L9.

Several ACs (e.g. AC-1, AC-2, AC-6, AC-10) list DELETE /api/deleteAccount (and, for AC-6, DELETE /api/verifyLogin) among their "endpoints" even though the AC's own quote does not require exercising that endpoint. This is grounded in the story's cleanup instruction (story.md#L23, "close (delete) every customer you create") rather than in the AC text itself; it is a reasonable test-mechanics choice, not an invented behavioural claim.

summary: All 42 checked refs (12 acceptance criteria, 8 rules, 13 error cases, 3 gaps, 6 endpoints) are fully grounded in the evidence pack with matching quotes, values and line citations; no invented, misread, incomplete or missed requirement-bearing content was found. Two minor citation-completeness observations are noted but do not affect correctness.
